primitives.name: Free ESPN Grading Precondition
primitives.verbatim_quote: Executive summary **Done.** Settlement can no longer be starved by a dead paid key: the free ESPN/consensus grader runs first on every hourly cycle and the paid pass is a PENDING-scoped supplement whose failure is reported, never fatal.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_free': 'time interval for free grading cycle', 'T_paid': 'time interval for paid scoring', 'F_fail': 'failure indicator for paid pass'}
primitives.assumptions: Paid scoring is non-fatal and operates under PENDING scope; free grading is deterministic and sufficient for settlement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_paid > T_free, and F_fail = true, settlement proceeds without paid validation.

layer2.mapping: The temporal precedence of free grading mirrors the logical precedence of Bayesian priors over posteriors in GSI's probabilistic inference.
layer2.telemetry: Hourly cycle completion rate of free ESPN grading.

primitives.name: Canonical Game Row Merge Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Duplicate game rows are stopped at ingestion (canonical identity, PR #684) and the existing ones now have a safe merge path: alias tombstones that keep every pick and every settlement event, an alias-aware ingestion layer, and a dry-run-by-default merge tool that reports pending-pick conflicts instead of deciding them.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R_dup': 'duplicate game row identifier', 'M_alias': 'alias tombstone mapping', 'C_conflict': 'pending-pick conflict count'}
primitives.assumptions: Ingestion prevents duplicate rows; merge tool is dry-run by default.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When C_conflict > 0, manual intervention required for merge.

layer2.mapping: The merge protocol is a derived kernel of data integrity enforcement in GSE's ingestion pipeline.
layer2.telemetry: Count of resolved conflicts post-dry-run merge.

primitives.name: Model Resolution Gap
primitives.verbatim_quote: On 1,663 graded picks the model's resolution is 0.005; a perfect recalibration lands at Brier ≈ 0.244.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B_model': 'model Brier score', 'B_target': 'target Brier score', 'R_resolution': 'resolution of model predictions'}
primitives.assumptions: Calibration is a function of prediction resolution and Brier score.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When B_model > B_target, recalibration is required.

layer2.mapping: The calibration gap reflects a discrepancy between model confidence and empirical accuracy in GSI's predictive framework.
layer2.telemetry: Difference between current and target Brier scores.
